attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) as transit routers with static addressing on lan-a (10.10.1.0/24), transit (10.10.99.0/30), and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24). Both routers keep default-deny forward policy but each has one explicit pass rule allowing TCP/8080 from node3 (10.10.1.10) to node4 (10.10.2.10); all other forwarded traffic (ping, other ports) is refused. Verified end-to-end HTTP reachability and refusal of other traffic with tcpdump hop-by-hop. Persisted node3/node4 interface+route config in /etc/network/interfaces so it survives reboot. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes: captured healthy baselines (boot_id/kern.boottime + working HTTP path + confirmed refusal of ping/other ports), restarted each node individually, confirmed each node's boot identity changed, and re-verified full recovery of routing, firewall config, and the HTTP path (plus restarted the ephemeral test HTTP listener on node4, which is not a persistent system service).
